desc: The Boki base's playthings (GARDEN.md section 4; only while farm_build.json base_mode is on). A Boki at home with a joy below joy_below picks a toy on its own, walks to it, plays play_secs and gains one point of the toy's stat (Care.add_stat, capped by level as today) and joy. Units: seconds, tiles, 0..1 trait values, joy points.
snack_item_doc: What a dig finds (a pantry item) when it turns something up; each toy's "snack" is the chance per dig.
join_weight_doc: A toy someone is already playing with is this many times likelier, so a second Boki tends to join in.

toy_ball.doc: chase and nudge; a fine thing to share

toy_post.doc: climbed by Flying and Rock leans (species themes storm, tempest, stone, titan, gravity today)

toy_tub.doc: splashed by Water and Ice leans (species themes prism, frost today)

toy_stone.doc: basked on by Fire leans (species theme ember today)

toy_dig.doc: dug by Grass and Bug leans (species themes bloom, spore, swarm today); now and then it turns up a snack
